items.title: He Was Given Two Circles… What He Did With Them Was GENIUS 😂 *JeThRo*
items.description: He Was Given Two Circles… What He Did With Them Was GENIUS! | Mike & Joelle React to Jethro This is one of the funniest Jethro jokes we've heard in a long time... and let's just say Joelle completely lost it at the ending. 🤣 The setup seems innocent enough: three young men are told to convince people not to take drugs using nothing but two circles. The first two come up with sensible ideas... but the third guy has a completely different strategy. 😳😂 Sometimes the oldest jokes have the biggest punchlines! A huge credit to the legendary Cornish comedian Jethro for this brilliant piece of comedy. We're simply reacting to and sharing one of our favourite Jethro jokes with our audience. items.title: Two Wives Tell Their Love-Making Stories… Then Their Husbands Tell THEIRS 😂
items.description: Two wives. Two husbands. The exact same nights… and FOUR completely different versions of what happened. 😂 Two women are comparing notes about their romantic evenings with their husbands. One describes an absolute disaster, while the other makes her night sound like something straight out of a fairy tale. ❤️ Then we hear what their husbands have to say… and suddenly those stories sound VERY different. 🤣 This hilarious husband vs wife joke proves one thing: there really are two sides to every story — especially in marriage! Joelle’s reaction as the husbands reveal what actually happened says it all. 😂 If you love marriage humor, husband and wife jokes, relationship comedy, funny couple videos and jokes with unexpected punchlines, you’re in the right place. 👉 Which version would YOU believe — hers or his? items.title: The Two Main Ingredients for a Lasting Marriage 🙄🤣 *Anthony Rodia*
items.description: Is love really the secret to a happy marriage… or is it distraction and a good sense of humor? 😂 Joelle reacts to a hilarious stand-up comedy bit from Anthony Rodia, as he explains his take on what REALLY keeps a marriage going — and apparently love might not be quite as important as his wife thought! 😂 As a married couple ourselves, this one definitely hit close to home. Anthony’s take on marriage, husbands, wives and surviving life together had Joelle cracking up — and probably agreeing with more of it than I’d like. 🤣 Original comedy and full credit: Anthony Rodia.
